title: Which tool categories should GA Forum rankings cover next?
body: The current rankings cover game development, livestreaming, esports and live video for business. Some categories you work with are probably missing, or covered in a way that does not match how you pick tools.

Tell us the category, the job the tool does and the two or three products you compare. Specific requests are easier to act on than broad ones, for example a niche task inside a pipeline rather than a whole field.

Vendors are welcome to suggest categories too, with the affiliation disclosed in the post. Suggestions do not buy a place in any ranking; how listings are handled is described in the [editorial process](/editorial-process).
